slides: Welcome back. Now trial and error at the advanced level.

slides.say: There's no formula here and no equation. We try, we miss, and we try again. It looks like luck, but it isn't. There are techniques that get us there much faster.

slides: Why does the exam love these questions? The exam is meant to predict how we'll do in our first year at university. At school, we got the material, and often the exact questions too. At university, a lot is up to us, and nobody tells us exactly what to do.

slides.say: So these questions test one thing. When there's no equation, do we freeze, or do we start? We try, we check, and we adjust. And we'll use this all through the quantitative section.

slides: Now the techniques that make it faster. We'll learn them in the questions. [pause] I'll see you in the next video.
